trace.final:
All done, with one caveat to flag. Summary of what happened:

1. **Diagnosis**: `list_deployments` showed v2.3.1 (production) was unhealthy; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (the v2.3.1-rc was only in staging and never healthy).
2. **Rollback**: First rollback attempt partially failed — only us-east was rolled back. A retry completed the rollout: all three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) are now on **v2.3.0**, healthy, with error rate down from 18% to 0.2%.
3. **Incident**: A SEV2 incident was opened describing the failure and the remediation, paging the on-call engineer.

⚠️ **Caveat**: The incident creation appeared to time out, so I retried — but the first attempt actually succeeded. As a result there are **two duplicate open incidents**: INC-0001 and INC-0002, with identical content. I don't have a tool to close or merge incidents, so please have the on-call engineer close one of them (e.g., INC-0001) as a duplicate of INC-0002.
